Connect your room

Real control runs locally beside your miner. Start the included bridge with a sensor URL and XMRig API token, then open http://127.0.0.1:8787.

python3 bridge.py

Sensor format: {"temperature": 21.4} in Celsius. Wallet and pool stay in your existing XMRig configuration.

LET’S GET CONNECTED

Your room, in real time.

This preview uses simulated temperatures and mining data. To control hardware, run the included local bridge on your mining computer and open its local address.

python3 bridge.py

Set EMBER_SENSOR_URL, EMBER_XMRIG_URL, and EMBER_XMRIG_TOKEN first. See the included README for setup.

Mining provides heat only. The app can stop adding heat, but cannot cool a room.
